transcript.content: Hi, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because people keep telling me I’m imagining things, but I’m not. My wife’s relative has been coming into our house to get at me. My tools don’t just move on their own, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. This has been going on for months, and it’s clear to me he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Have you ever heard or seen this relative in the house when no one else was there?
I don’t know that I’ve actually seen him standing there, no. Or heard his voice clear like that. I just notice things after—stuff moved, things not right. That’s how I know someone’s been in there.
Have you ever felt that someone was controlling your thoughts?
No, I don’t think anyone’s controlling my thoughts. My thoughts are my own. I’m just trying to figure out what’s going on around me.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
No, I haven’t been hearing voices when I’m alone. I notice things afterward, like stuff moved, but I’m not hearing anybody talking to me.
During this time, have you also had periods where your mood was unusually high or low?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve been upset at times, but I wouldn’t say my mood was unusually high or unusually low. Nothing like that really stands out to me.
Have you had any recent medical illness or injury to your head?
Not that I can think of. I haven’t had any head injury recently, and I don’t think I’ve been sick with anything major.
Have you found yourself becoming much less interested in being around other people than you used to be?

Yeah, I guess I have. I don’t really feel like being around him at home, so I keep to myself more. I spend a lot of time locking things up and checking the workshop, and I don’t leave my equipment where I used to.

It’s made things tense with my wife, but I’m still getting to work and handling what I need to day to day.
If someone showed you clear proof that your wife’s relative had not been entering the house, would you be able to accept that?

I don’t know what “clear proof” would even look like at this point. I know what’s been happening. My tools don’t move around by themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident.

Everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining it, but I can see it plainly. He’s been coming into the house, getting at me, trying to take over my place and push me out. So no, I don’t think I’d just accept someone telling me he hasn’t been doing it.
Have you found that your emotions feel noticeably flat or that other people say you seem less expressive than before?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’m upset and tense a lot, but I don’t feel like my emotions are flat. Nobody’s really told me I seem less expressive, at least not that I can think of.
Have you used methamphetamine, cocaine, cannabis, or any other drugs around the time this started?
No, not that I can think of. I don’t use meth or cocaine or anything like that. I mean, I’ve had a drink here and there, but drugs weren’t part of this starting.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being broadcast so that other people could know what you were thinking?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve never felt like my thoughts were going out where people could hear them or know them. That’s not really what this has been about.
Have other people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?
No, I don’t think anyone’s said that to me. I feel like I talk pretty normally. Maybe I get worked up sometimes, but I don’t think I jump all over the place or anything.
Have you ever heard voices talking about you when no one else was there?
No, I haven’t had that. I don’t hear voices talking about me when I’m alone or anything like that.
Did these beliefs start after a medical problem?
I don’t think so. I can’t point to some medical problem where it started after that. Nothing like that comes to mind.
Have these beliefs about your wife’s relative been present continuously for at least three months?
Yes. It’s been going on for about nine months now, since my wife’s relative moved into our home. It hasn’t really stopped during that time.
Has anything happened that you believe would be impossible in ordinary life, like someone entering your mind or controlling events in a supernatural way?

No, not like someone getting inside my mind or some supernatural thing. It’s ordinary stuff, but it’s obvious to me. My wife’s relative came into this house to get at me. My tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. After all these months, I can see he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Have you lost motivation to do everyday things you used to keep up with?

No, not really. I still get up, go to the plant, do my assembler work, keep the bills paid, and take care of myself the way I always have. The problem is more what’s going on at home with him and my things.
